Package be.imgn.json

@NullMarked package be.imgn.json
Parsing and writing RFC 8259 JSON.
  • Class
    Description
    JsonArray
    A JSON array: values, in order.
    JsonBinder<T>
    Reads a type from a stream and writes it to one.
    JsonBindings
    Reads the values that the code generated for JsonRecord types binds from strings, and checks the type of a JsonValue.
    JsonBoolean
    A JSON boolean.
    JsonDocument
    A parsed document: its root value, and where each of its values is written.
    JsonException
    Thrown when a document cannot be read: it is not valid JSON, or it does not bind to the type it is read as.
    JsonMappingException
    Thrown when a valid document does not bind to the type it is read as: a value of the wrong type, a number out of range, a missing or unknown member, or a value the type rejects.
    JsonName
    Gives the name of a record component's member, the string of an enum constant, or the tag that names a record in a sealed interface, in place of its Java name.
    JsonNames
    Member names known in advance, for JsonStreamReader.name(JsonNames) to match without creating a String, and for JsonStreamWriter.name(JsonNames, int) to write already encoded.
    JsonNull
    The JSON null.
    JsonNumber
    A JSON number, kept exactly as written: it is converted only when one of the as methods is called.
    JsonObject
    A JSON object: members with distinct names, in the order of the document or of their insertion.
    JsonObject.Builder
    Builds an object, keeping the order of the members.
    JsonParseException
    Thrown when a document is not valid JSON, or exceeds a limit of the parser.
    JsonParser
    Parses RFC 8259 JSON strictly: a document that is not valid JSON, has an object with two members of the same name, or exceeds a limit, is rejected with a JsonParseException.
    JsonParser.Builder
    Builds a parser.
    JsonPosition
    A position in a document: a line and a column.
    JsonRecord
    Marks a record, or a sealed interface of records, that documents bind to, with [JsonParser#parseAs(Class, byte[])], and that JsonWriter.formatAs(Class, Object) writes.
    JsonStreamReader
    Reads a document value by value, as typed reads.
    JsonStreamWriter
    Writes a document value by value, as UTF-8, compact or pretty as the JsonWriter that created it.
    JsonString
    A JSON string.
    JsonTagMember
    Lays out a sealed interface as an object of its record whose tag member names the record, wherever it is among the members: {"type": "circle", "radius": 1}.
    JsonType
    The type of a JSON value.
    JsonValue
    A JSON value.
    JsonWrapper
    Lays out a sealed interface as an object with one member, named after the record, whose value is the record: {"circle": {"radius": 1}}.
    JsonWriter
    Writes values as JSON, in UTF-8: compact, the default, or pretty, indented with 2 spaces.
    JsonWriter.Builder
    Builds a writer.
    UnknownMembers
    What binding does with a member of an object that no component of the record takes.
